legacy_preservation.preservation_target: All LEGACY_REFACTOR and LEGACY_FACTORY classified files
legacy_preservation.stash_command: git stash push -m "E21-R1: Legacy factory refactor + dev tools (E1/E2 agents, factory tools, web tools, API server, migration scripts)" src/factory/agents/ src/factory/context/memory.py src/factory/events/bus.py src/factory/tools/__init__.py src/llm/structured.py src/factory/tools/web.py src/factory/api_server.py scripts/add_checkpoint_method.py scripts/add_replan_events.py scripts/add_replan_models.py scripts/check_tests.py scripts/create_manifest.py scripts/e20_factory_integration_proof.py scripts/insert_e13_methods.py scripts/remove_duplicate_execute.py test.txt

preservation_verification.pre_stash_status: All files present in worktree with modifications/untracked

rationale.why_stash_not_branch: Stash preserves exact worktree state without creating branch history; legacy refactor is incomplete and conflicts with canonical unified runtime direction; can be restored later if needed
rationale.why_not_discard: Legacy refactor represents development work on E1/E2 factory architecture; may be useful for reference or future migration
rationale.why_not_commit: Incomplete refactor; mixes legacy patterns with new tool_registry parameter; not part of canonical E20 runtime; would pollute main

legacy_preservation.restoration_procedure: git stash pop (or git stash apply <stash_id>) to restore legacy work
